notes.title: Localisation
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

some time ago, we’ve hinted about localizing Pine Seekers in other languages! 
So far, the store exists in both English and German. The Chinese version is on the way!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9yOxkAN.png[/img]

All that’s left for us is changing some in-game interfaces! On the side, we’re still trying to polish whatever we can on the game until release date.
Example: Slightly changed our water shader. Simple, but gives the environment a much more lively feeling!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IAPHTUM.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9Rc1uYG.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/niftyproductions/pine-seekers-online-multiplayer-bomberman?ref=nav_search]As a reminder: Our pre-sale Kickstarter campaign is still on-going! You can grab a copy of the game with at least 40% discount there.[/url]


Cheers,
Nifty Productions
